name: sonarqube
description: Connect SonarQube Cloud to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use SonarQube Cloud MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect SonarQube Cloud to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with code quality and security issues using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my SonarQube Cloud workspace.
Find anything in SonarQube Cloud that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review code quality and security issues in SonarQube Cloud.
